context_summary: Batch plan for 5 features: F72 (Treasure Token Full Art — frontend modal), F73 (Scan Hygiene — reset + stale detection, backend), F74 (Admin User CRUD — create/delete + first-access password, full-stack), F75 (Admin Accordion — consolidate admin pages into collapsible sections, frontend), F76 (Playwright Windows Fix — suppress NotImplementedError traceback, backend). 3 waves: Wave 0 parallel (F72, F73, F76), Wave 1 (F74), Wave 2 (F75 depends on F74).

options_considered.description: Proceed with plan-feature for all 5 features in the proposed wave structure.
pros: Well-organized parallelism — 3 independent features in Wave 0
All features are well-scoped and low-to-medium complexity
cons: F75 is a larger refactor (moving 3 pages into accordion)
5 features in one batch is ambitious

options_considered.description: Split into smaller batches — plan Wave 0 first, defer F74+F75.
pros: Can validate Wave 0 before committing to admin refactor
cons: Delays admin improvements the user explicitly requested
No technical reason to defer — all requirements are clear

rationale: All 5 features have clear requirements, the user confirmed admin scope (Liga Status, Schedules, Scans are admin; BanList is not). Wave structure maximizes parallelism. No blockers or unknowns.
